reason_for_choice: A developmental original MAST TGLC FITS had all PSF measurements missing but usable calibrated aperture photometry. Selection does NOT depend on original class label.
TGLC_flags_policy: report only; do not exclude in main pipeline
raw_cadence_filter: finite time AND finite positive cal_aper_flux
normalization: single median of per-source accepted flux
warning: This policy was chosen on previously examined stars. No performance from these sources is independent, and TGLC calibrated aperture depths may be diluted by contamination.
